# 决议类别、决议与条件

[API 任务入口](../../index.md) · [公开模块](../index.md)

先用 `Decision` 描述单项决议，再放入 `DecisionCategory.decisions`。类别控制一组决议的可见性和解锁条件；决议自己的条件控制这一项是否出现、能否点击。`completeEffect` 是玩家执行决议时的效果，`cost` 是政治点数成本。

所有条件与效果回调在游戏的国家作用域中解释。需要更多原生任务字段时，可查询 [原生内容领域](../../domains.md) 的 `NativeDecision` 与 `NativeDecisionCategory`；下方是日常写作时更紧凑的类型化入口。

## 使用示例

```ts
import { Decision, DecisionCategory } from "krieg-lang/hoi4";

DecisionCategory({
  id: "recovery_programme",
  decisions: [Decision({
    id: "fund_reconstruction", cost: 25,
    completeEffect: country => country.effects.addStability(0.05),
  })],
});
```

## DecisionCategory() { #decisioncategory }

> **DecisionCategory**(`spec`: [`DecisionCategorySpec`](#decisioncategoryspec)): [`IdentifiedDefinition`](scope-selection.md#identifieddefinition)

Defined in: [src/sdk/index.ts:336](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/sdk/index.ts#L336)

Group decisions under one category. `available` checks whether a decision may be taken; `completeEffect` describes the effect of taking it.

### Parameters { #decisioncategory-section-parameters }

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `spec` | [`DecisionCategorySpec`](#decisioncategoryspec) |

### Returns { #decisioncategory-section-returns }

[`IdentifiedDefinition`](scope-selection.md#identifieddefinition)

### Example { #decisioncategory-section-example }

```ts
DecisionCategory({ id: "council_budget", decisions: [{
  id: "council_vote", cost: 25,
  available: country => !country.isAI,
  completeEffect: country => country.effects.setCountryFlag("council_voted"),
}] });
```
